_meta.note: Deployer-facing disclosure rules used by rules/engine.py disclosure_check(). Not legal advice. Each item has confidence + last_verified; dates are the ones researched on 2026-10-14.

jurisdictions.name: European Union: AI Act Art. 50
jurisdictions.status: in force (grace to 2026-12-02 for Art. 50(2) marking on systems already on the market; interoperable detection expected by 2027-02-02)
jurisdictions.penalty: Up to €15M or 3% of worldwide turnover

obligations.provider_marking: Art. 50(2): outputs must be marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as AI-generated/manipulated. Code of Practice (final 10 Jun 2026): signed, time-stamped metadata (C2PA-style) + imperceptible watermark required; fingerprinting/logging optional.
obligations.deepfake_label: Art. 50(4): deployers must disclose that image/audio/video deepfakes are artificially generated or manipulated; use the EU 'AI' icon set where available. Artistic/satirical works: disclose in a way that does not hamper display.
obligations.text_public_interest: Art. 50(4) 2nd para: AI-generated text published to inform the public on matters of public interest must be disclosed unless human-reviewed with editorial responsibility.
obligations.interaction: Art. 50(1)/(3): chatbot and emotion-recognition/biometric categorisation disclosures.
obligations.retroactive: No retroactive labelling of content created before the obligations apply.

sources: EU Code of Practice on AI-generated content (10 Jun 2026)

jurisdictions.name: California: SB 942 / AB 853 (AI Transparency Act)
jurisdictions.penalty: $5,000 per violation per day (AG / city attorney)

obligations.provider_detection_tool: Covered providers must offer a free, public AI detection tool with an API that reports provider, system + version, timestamp and unique ID when present.
obligations.latent_disclosure: Covered providers must embed a latent disclosure (provider name, system name + version, creation timestamp, unique identifier) that is permanent/extremely difficult to remove to the extent technically feasible.
obligations.manifest_disclosure: Optional visible/manifest disclosure that the user may toggle; must be clear and conspicuous.
obligations.licensee_duty: Licensees who strip latent disclosures lose the licence; providers must revoke within 96 hours.
obligations.platform_duty_2027: Large online platforms must detect and surface provenance data (or its absence) on uploaded content.
obligations.capture_device_2028: Capture devices sold in CA must offer provenance embedding (C2PA-style) by 1 Jan 2028.

jurisdictions.notes: Monthly-user threshold for 'covered provider' reported both as >1M and as removed; verify against the enrolled text before relying on it.

jurisdictions.name: India: IT (Intermediary Guidelines) Amendment Rules 2026 (Synthetically Generated Information)
jurisdictions.status: in force; 21 Apr 2026 draft proposes a continuous visible label
jurisdictions.penalty: Loss of safe harbour (Sec. 79) for intermediaries; takedown within 3 hours of order

obligations.label: SGI must carry a prominent label (visible for visual media / audible for audio; the 2025 draft specified ≥10% of the display area; the enrolled rule says 'prominent').
obligations.metadata: Permanent unique metadata/identifier embedded in SGI that identifies it as synthetic and, where feasible, the generating service.
obligations.no_removal: Intermediaries must not enable modification, suppression or removal of the label/metadata.
obligations.ssmi_verification: Significant social media intermediaries must obtain a user declaration on upload and deploy reasonable technical measures to verify it.
obligations.takedown: Unlawful SGI must be removed within 3 hours of a government/court order.

jurisdictions.name: China: Labeling Measures + GB 45438-2025
jurisdictions.penalty: Administrative penalties under CAC rules; platforms must enforce

obligations.explicit_label: Explicit labels: text ≥5% of shortest side for images; voice prompts for audio; start-of-video markers; AI-interaction notices.
obligations.implicit_label: Implicit metadata: producer name, content ID, and service provider in file metadata (GB 45438 defines field names).
obligations.platform_verify: Platforms must check implicit labels on upload and add their own label if missing or suspected.
obligations.no_removal: Removal, alteration or forgery of labels is prohibited; 6-month logs.

jurisdictions.name: South Korea: AI Basic Act
jurisdictions.status: in force; enforcement decree details labelling

obligations.label: Generative AI outputs must be labelled; deepfakes that are hard to distinguish from reality require clear notice.
obligations.notice: Users must be notified when a product/service is AI-driven.

jurisdictions.name: United States (federal): TAKE IT DOWN Act + FTC Act §5
jurisdictions.status: in force (platform 48h removal duty for intimate deepfakes from May 2026)
jurisdictions.penalty: Criminal penalties (TAKE IT DOWN); FTC enforcement for deceptive practices

obligations.ncii_removal: Covered platforms must remove non-consensual intimate imagery (incl. AI) within 48 hours of a valid request.
obligations.deception: Presenting synthetic media as authentic in commerce can be a deceptive practice (FTC Act §5); no general labelling mandate.
